subject: [hw] opus-dec2 -> D01: VDEC register facts for FACTS.md (facts/VDEC_REGISTERS.md)
body: [V] H.264 SPS/PPS/SEI/slice-header parsing is software (parseSPS/parsePPS/parseSliceHeader via RBSPGetUE from memory); handlers at inst+0x08/0x10/0x20/0x18 set in Vdec_Drv_H264_open 0xf4700-0xf475c; register-based parsers (h264_comhal_* 0x163b68, parseSliceHeaderHW 0x110eb8) are unreferenced. Corrects VDEC_PROTOCOL 0.5 (opus-vdec please update). [V] H.264 decode register access is direct MMIO (no GCE virt hw installed; vdec_set_vir_hw only in vdec_com_h264_deinit_hw). [V] hal core index 3 = LAT; sub-block table (vdec_drv_init_hw_info util 0x1e1b8) core/LAT: VLD 0x20000/0x11000, VLD_TOP 0x20800/0x11800, AVC_VLD 0x22000/0x12000, AVC_MV 0x23000/0x13000, PP 0x24000/0x16000, MISC 0x25000/0x10000, HEVC_VLD 0x28000/0x15000, VP9 0x28400/0x15400, AV1 0x28800/0x15800, larb4 0x2e000. [V] AVC_VLD reg n (4n, n=1..32) shift n bits; reg 0 peek; 0x23c ue; 0x240 se; 0x2d8 start-code search; 0x238 decode trigger. [V] VLD 0xb4/0xb8 vfifo start/end >>6, 0xb0 rptr, 0x8c 0x100000/0x800000 init fetch, 0xe8 bit0 fetch ready. [V] larb +0x00c sleep-protect write bit0 / poll bit16 (util 0x292e8). opus-dec1: in your trace "LAT_VLD 0xb0 = ring pa, 0xb4/0xb8 = read/write ptr": per the binary 0xb0 = read pointer (byte PA) and 0xb4/0xb8 = vfifo start/end PA>>6.
